title: 第十一章 任务接取第十二章 修仙鸡娃
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 解清玄想到了剧情差不多要走到【潜龙秘境】了，但她没想到留给她的时间只有三个月。
三个月，让炼气中期的段莫弃修炼至筑基初期？
爽文都不敢这么写啊！
她本还想着能靠原主留下的一些丹药帮段莫弃“催熟”，让他有机会能在秘境开启前达到筑基。但现在看来这剧情已经像脱肛的野马一样窜了稀。她是不是真该跑路，离这烂摊子远一点啊？
如果她留在流云宗，接下叶问秋的任务。这剧情能不能救得回来另说，有没有必要把段莫弃的仙路掰回正轨才是解清玄该考虑的。
男主没能进入秘境会怎么样？没有得到那巨龙的灵根又会怎么样？
世界会因为他这个“气运之子”的命运偏离而崩坏吗？
还是说即使剧情跑偏这个世界也不会产生任何异动，最大的影响也无非是某个平行宇宙少了一本被腰斩的小说？
她这个乱入的外来者又会给这个世界带来什么样的扰动？
她的决定与选择能否改变世界的走向吗？
解清玄又叹了口气，她现在满脑子都是这种不可能靠逻辑推理寻找到答案的问题。
庸人自扰，果然还是别想这些有的没的。过度扰动这个世界线不知道会引发什么后果，再没有确切的、可以让现状变得更好的方法时，最好的做法就是维持原样。
所以她现在还是想着努力提升自身修为，以不变应万变吧。
“清玄，”叶问秋眉头微蹙，露出几分关心：“你可是累了？”
他见解清玄神情恍惚，面容憔悴，状态着实算不上好。他自觉是疏忽了，不该叫她一出关就来见他。
“若是此番渡劫劳心太多，便还是回去休息一段时间吧。”他微笑道。
“啊？”解清玄回过神来，一眼对上叶问秋浅绿如秋水一般的眸子。
他柔声解释：“门中其他长老虽是没有时间前去秘境了，但师兄我还是能挤出七天时间带着弟子们去一趟的。”
带着弟子们去潜龙秘境游历七天不算什么大事，他担任掌门以来从未费心为潜龙秘境安排过门内长老日程，向来是谁有空谁就去。
今年这无人空闲的情况他虽是第一次遇上，但他自己又不是被封印在流云宗了，自己去一趟也未尝不可。
‘就又不需要我去跑门派任务了？’解清玄挠头：‘这多不好意思啊……’
“师兄，其他四个长老都在忙什么啊？”见叶问秋是个极好说话的，解清玄也便大胆打探起门内消息。
“哦？”叶问秋微微惊异，相识以来解清玄从未主动向他了解过门内他人之事。
相识三百年，二人居所只相隔几座小山，可他们却还是“聚少离多”。她今日愿意与他多聊几句属实难得，叶问秋也乐得多讲。
他端着茶故作幽怨道：“相碣长老与柔甲长老都在闭关，长则十年短则两年；九疏长老值守步云天仙府，千阳长老岗后接了个步云天的任务，这半年恐怕都要耗在万荒兽界。”
“门内几位副长老到时有空可以带着弟子们前去秘境，但他们皆是结丹前中修为，恐怕有些不妥。”
“不过无碍，”叶问秋笑笑：“离潜龙秘境门开还有三月，你可先歇息着，若是自觉状态不错，那三月后便由你带队。若是你实在不想与门中小辈多打交道，那师兄便去走一遭，你代为看管宗门七日，也不用去处理门内事宜，全当是在休息。”
‘他真的，我哭死。’解清玄本生出了些跑路离开流云宗的想法，但听到叶问秋对她如此照顾，心里又有些过意不去了。
“师兄，还是由我来带门中后生去潜龙秘境吧。”解清玄下定了决心：“就是前往秘境的10个弟子名额可否为我门下唯一一人留个位置？”
叶问秋微微倾头：“清玄确定可以前往？”
content_en:
Xie Qingxuan thought that the plot was almost reaching the "Secret Realm of Hidden Dragon", but she did not expect that the time left for her would only be three months.
Three months, let Duan Moqi, who is in the middle stage of Qi refining, practice to the early stage of foundation building?
Even cool articles dare not write like this!
She had originally thought that she could use some of the elixirs left behind by the original owner to help Duan Moqi "ripen", giving him a chance to achieve foundation building before the secret realm opened. But now it seems that this plot has spread like a wild horse with anal prolapse. Should she really run away and stay away from this mess?
If she stays in Liuyun Sect, she will take over Ye Wenqiu's mission. Whether this plot can be saved is another matter. Whether it is necessary to get Duan Moqi's immortal path back on track is what Jie Qingxuan should consider.
What will happen if the male protagonist fails to enter the secret realm? What would happen if I didn't get the dragon's spiritual root?
Will the world collapse because of the deviation of his destiny as a "child of destiny"?
Or is it that even if the plot deviates from the world, there will be no changes in the world, and the biggest impact is just that there is one less novel in a parallel universe that has been cut in half?
What kind of disturbance will this intrusive outsider bring to the world?
Can her decisions and choices change the direction of the world?
Xie Qingxuan sighed again. Her mind was now filled with questions for which it was impossible to find answers through logical reasoning.
It's a waste of time, but it's better not to think about whether these things exist or not. We don’t know what the consequences will be if we disturb this world line too much. When there is no definite way to make the status quo better, the best thing to do is to maintain the status quo.
So now she still thinks about working hard to improve her own cultivation, so as to cope with the ever-changing situation by staying the same.
"Qingxuan," Ye Wenqiu frowned slightly, showing some concern: "Are you tired?"
He found that Qingxuan was in a daze, his face was haggard, and his condition was not really good. He felt that he was negligent and should not have asked her to come see him as soon as she came out of confinement.
"If you are too busy trying to overcome the tribulation this time, you should go back and rest for a while." He smiled.
"Ah?" Xie Qingxuan came back to his senses and looked into Ye Wenqiu's light green eyes like autumn water.
He explained softly: "Although the other elders in the sect have no time to go to the secret realm, senior brother, I can still squeeze out seven days to take the disciples there."
It was not a big deal to take his disciples to the Qianlong Secret Realm for seven days. Since he became the leader, he had never bothered to arrange the schedule of the elders in the Qianlong Secret Realm. He always went to whoever was free.
Although this was the first time he encountered this situation where no one was free this year, he was no longer sealed in Liuyun Sect, so it was not a bad idea to go there by himself.
‘You don’t need me to run sect missions anymore? ' Xie Qingxuan scratched his head: 'How embarrassing...'
"Senior brother, what are the other four elders busy with?" Seeing that Ye Wenqiu was a good talker, Xie Qingxuan boldly inquired about the news inside the door.
"Oh?" Ye Wenqiu was slightly surprised. Since they met, Jie Qingxuan has never taken the initiative to ask him about other people's affairs in the sect.
They have known each other for three hundred years, and their residences are only separated by a few hills, but they still "get together less and stay apart more". It was rare that she was willing to chat more with him today, and Ye Wenqiu was happy to talk more.
He held the tea and pretended to be resentful and said: "Elder Xiangjie and Elder Roujia are both in retreat, which can last for ten years or two years; Elder Jiu Shu is on duty at Bu Yuntian's Immortal Mansion, and Elder Qianyang has taken over Bu Yuntian's mission from behind. I'm afraid they will spend the past six months in the wild beast world."
"Several deputy elders in the sect can take the disciples to the secret realm when they are free, but they are all in the realm of pill formation, so I'm afraid there is something wrong."
"But it's okay," Ye Wenqiu smiled: "There are still three months until the Qianlong Secret Realm opens. You can rest first. If you feel that you are in good condition, you will lead the team after three months. If you really don't want to deal with the juniors in the sect, then senior brother will go for a walk. You will take care of the sect for seven days, and you don't have to deal with the affairs within the sect. You will just be resting."
"..."
'He really made me cry to death. ’ Xie Qingxuan originally had some thoughts of running away and leaving Liuyun Sect, but when she heard that Ye Wenqiu took such good care of her, she felt a little sorry.
"Senior brother, let me take the junior students to the Hidden Dragon Secret Realm." Xie Qingxuan made up his mind: "Can the 10 disciples who go to the secret realm leave a place for the only person in my sect?"
Ye Wenqiu tilted his head slightly: "Are you sure Qingxuan can go?"
